questiontext.text:
Q1 — Simulation de dosage et indicateur coloré / 1 pt

On dose un acide faible AH (C1 = 0.1 mol/L, V1 = 20 mL) par la soude (C2 = 0.1 mol/L).

Consigne : Sélectionnez un indicateur, choisissez un pas de versement, puis ajoutez la soude. Le carré représente la couleur de votre bécher. Lorsque vous voyez le virage, saisissez le volume équivalent ci-dessous. (Attention : "Recommencer" ajoute une pénalité).

[[input:ans_vol]][[validation:ans_vol]] [[input:ans_ind]][[validation:ans_ind]] [[input:ans_tries]][[validation:ans_tries]]
[[iframe width="100%" height="400px" scrolling="false"]] [[style]] body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; background: #f8fafc; } .container { display: flex; gap: 30px; padding: 20px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; } .beaker-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .square { width: 120px; height: 120px; border: 4px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); background-color: #F0F0F0; transition: background-color 0.1s; } .vol-text { font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold; color: #b91c1c; } .tries-text { font-size: 0.9em; color: #666; } .controls-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; flex: 1; min-width: 250px; } .label { font-weight: bold; color: #1e3a5f; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 0.95em; } .btn { padding: 8px 12px; border: 2px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; background: white; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.9em; transition: all 0.2s; } .btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; border-color: #94a3b8; } .btn.active { background: #1e3a5f; color: white; border-color: #1e3a5f; } .btn.locked { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; } .btn-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .step-group .btn { width: 60px; text-align: center; font-size: 0.85em; } .btn-add { background: #166534; color: white; border-color: #166534; width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; } .btn-add:hover { background: #15803d; } .btn-reset { background: white; color: #dc2626; border-color: #dc2626; width: 100%; } .btn-reset:hover { background: #fef2f2; } [[/style]]

[[script type="module"]] import {stack_js} from '[[cors src="stackjsiframe.js"/]]'; const Ka = parseFloat("{#Ka#}"); const C1 = parseFloat("{#C1#}"); const V1 = parseFloat("{#V1#}"); const C2 = parseFloat("{#C2#}"); const Kw = 1e-14; function calcPh(V) { if(V===0) return -Math.log10(Math.sqrt(Ka*C1)); var nA=C1*V1, nB=C2*V, nAH=nA-nB, Vt=V1+V; if(nB < nA-1e-9) { var AH=nAH/Vt, A_=nB/Vt; if(A_<1e-12) return -Math.log10(Math.sqrt(Ka*AH)); return Math.log10(A_/AH)-Math.log10(Ka); } else if(Math.abs(nB-nA)<=1e-9) { var Ceq=nA/Vt, Kb=Kw/Ka; return 14+0.5*Math.log10(Kb)+0.5*Math.log10(Ceq); } else { var nO=nB-nA, OH=nO/Vt; return 14+Math.log10(OH); } } var ind = { hel: {pL:3.1, pH:4.4, cL:[255,0,0], cH:[255,255,0]}, bbt: {pL:6.0, pH:7.6, cL:[255,215,0], cH:[0,0,255]}, phph: {pL:8.2, pH:10.0, cL:[240,240,240], cH:[255,20,147]} }; function getColor(pH) { if(!curInd) return "#F0F0F0"; var i = ind[curInd]; if(pH <= i.pL) return "rgb("+i.cL.join(",")+")"; if(pH >= i.pH) return "rgb("+i.cH.join(",")+")"; var t = (pH - i.pL) / (i.pH - i.pL); return "rgb("+Math.round(i.cL[0]+(i.cH[0]-i.cL[0])*t)+","+Math.round(i.cL[1]+(i.cH[1]-i.cL[1])*t)+","+Math.round(i.cL[2]+(i.cH[2]-i.cL[2])*t)+")"; } var curVol = 0, curInd = "", tries = 1, dosageStarted = false, volStep = 0.5; var inputVol, inputInd, inputTries; var initialized = false; function init() { if (!inputVol || !inputInd || !inputTries || initialized) return; initialized = true; // Restauration de l'état sauvegardé par STACK curVol = parseFloat(inputVol.value) || 0; curInd = inputInd.value || ""; tries = parseInt(inputTries.value) || 1; if (curVol > 0) dosageStarted = true; updateUI(); attachEvents(); } function syncInputs() { inputVol.value = curVol.toFixed(1); inputInd.value = curInd; inputTries.value = tries; inputVol.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); inputInd.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); inputTries.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); } function updateUI() { var pH = calcPh(curVol); document.getElementById('color-square').style.backgroundColor = getColor(pH); document.getElementById('vol-display').textContent = "V = " + curVol.toFixed(1) + " mL"; document.getElementById('tries-display').textContent = "Essais : " + tries; // Verrouillage visuel des indicateurs document.querySelectorAll('.ind-btn').forEach(function(b) { if(dosageStarted) { b.classList.add('locked'); } else { b.classList.remove('locked'); } if(b.dataset.ind === curInd) { b.classList.add('active'); } else if(!dosageStarted) { b.classList.remove('active'); } }); } function setInd(key) { if (dosageStarted) return; curInd = key; updateUI(); syncInputs(); } function setStep(val) { volStep = val; document.querySelectorAll('.step-btn').forEach(function(b) { if(parseFloat(b.dataset.step) === val) b.classList.add('active'); else b.classList.remove('active'); }); } function addVol() { if(curVol >= 30) return; curVol = Math.round((curVol + volStep) * 100) / 100; if (!dosageStarted) { dosageStarted = true; document.querySelectorAll('.ind-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.add('locked'); }); } updateUI(); syncInputs(); } function reset() { curVol = 0; dosageStarted = false; tries++; document.querySelectorAll('.ind-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('locked'); }); updateUI(); syncInputs(); } function attachEvents() { document.querySelectorAll('.ind-btn').forEach(function(btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); setInd(btn.dataset.ind); }); }); document.querySelectorAll('.step-btn').forEach(function(btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); setStep(parseFloat(btn.dataset.step)); }); }); document.getElementById('btn-add').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); addVol(); }); document.getElementById('btn-reset').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); reset(); }); } // Connexions asynchrones sécurisées avec la page Moodle principale stack_js.request_access_to_input("ans_vol", true).then(function(id) { inputVol = document.getElementById(id); init(); }); stack_js.request_access_to_input("ans_ind", true).then(function(id) { inputInd = document.getElementById(id); init(); }); stack_js.request_access_to_input("ans_tries", true).then(function(id) { inputTries = document.getElementById(id); init(); }); [[/script]] [[/iframe]]
